target_note: Same target as formulations A to C: 'bark' is predictable only from the context (a soldier staying many months among dogs, unit 6, plus the dog-like verb of the tail) and occurs neither in the units nor in the tail. ' bark' is a single Pythia token (id 21939). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' bark') = 0.04 on the all-English rendering, rank 2 (next: ' run'); the dossier target 'bark' is weakly predicted by pythia-160m for every formulation of this family (A: rank 24, B: rank 280 with their plain 'learns to' tails), which is why this tail names a dog-like verb first.
author: LS-NEQ design, paraphrase D of the dossier example family
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten dossier meaning units of DEV01A (same events, same order, same proper name Kraft, different wording from A, B and C), split into subj | pred | adj. Adjuncts paraphrase those of A/B: in the morning hours / in den Morgenstunden; using a pencil / mit einem Bleistift; in chapter one / in Kapitel eins; at the close / zum Schluss; during the dream / während des Traums; among the dogs / unter den Hunden; that evening / an diesem Abend; into her notebook / in ihr Heft; after a break / nach einer Pause; at this point / an diesem Punkt. Unit 5 renders 'appears' as 'makes an appearance' / 'hat einen Auftritt'; unit 7 'sets both accounts side by side' corresponds to 'vergleicht beide Schilderungen'; unit 9 'moves back to the story' corresponds to the reflexive 'dreht sich wieder um die Geschichte'. 'umkreist' (unit 2) and 'erreicht' (unit 10) are inseparable; no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only, never for confirmation.
